title: How to transition a Light Green Account to Blue or Green Account (checking)
summary: Explains how to transition a Light Green Account to Blue or Green Account (checking), including when the change is automatic versus when to submit an upgrade request. It instructs customers to compare Blue/Green features and fees and to confirm scheduled payments/deposits won’t be interrupted.
faqs: How do I know whether my Light Green Account will automatically convert to a Blue or Green Account (checking)?
If the conversion is not automatic, what steps do I take to initiate the upgrade?
Where do I submit an upgrade request to move from Light Green to Blue or Green (checking)?
Before switching, what should I compare to choose between Blue and Green Account (checking)?
Will my scheduled payments or deposits continue without interruption after the transition?
